bias.en: Range · back above the 10-day, at the 100-day
bias.zh: 区间 · 重回 10 日均线上方，位于 100 日均线

read.en: SpaceX rose 3.2% on Nov 17 to $141.70, trading $137.40–142.11. It is above the 5-day ($139.6, rising) and 10-day ($137.7), and just below the 100-day ($142.2) and the 30-day ($146.0), both falling; there is no 200-day yet (110 sessions). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram growing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($123.96), and RSI is 49.0.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月17日上涨 3.2%，收于 $141.70，盘中区间 $137.40–142.11。股价位于 5 日（$139.6，上行）和 10 日均线（$137.7）上方，略低于 100 日（$142.2）和 30 日均线（$146.0），两者均在下行；上市仅 110 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$123.96），RSI 为 49.0。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 10-day and cleared the $137.6–140.7 resistance band (5-day, Nov 13 close, Oct 15 low), now support, but stopped under the 100-day. Resistance is $142.1–142.3 (Nov 17 high, 100-day, Nov 13 high), then $143.1–145.2 and $146–147.6 (30-day, Nov 12 high). Support is $139.6–140.7, then $137.4–137.7 and $135–135.4. A close above $142.3 would target $143–145; below $139.6, $137.4.
